children.game_version: A 'follow the leader' jumping game where children mimic the height of the leader.

avoid: Straining the shoulders with high arm holds
seniors.seated_version: Perform the 'horn' arm gestures and rhythmic handclapping while seated.
seniors.standing_version: Gentle rhythmic swaying and heel lifts instead of full jumps.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduce tempo to 50%; focus on upper body movement.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Arms raised above the head, curved inward to mimic cattle horns.
movement_profile.footwork: Vertical jumping from the balls of the feet; rhythmic stepping in circular formations.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Participatory circle or open communal gathering space.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Stable torso to facilitate vertical height.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: High vertical leaps are the primary feature.
movement_profile.partnering: None; individual display within a collective group.
movement_profile.posture: Erect, straight-backed during the leap; arms held high in a curved 'horn' shape.

signature_moves.description: Raising both arms above the head and curving them to represent the horns of a bull.
signature_moves.name: The Horn Gesture

signature_moves.description: A high jump performed from a standing start to demonstrate physical strength.
signature_moves.name: The Vertical Leap

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid improvisation before mastering the traditional form; respect the gender-segregated roles of the specific performance.

music_profile.musical_form: Functional and repetitive, designed for endurance.
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Simultaneous beats of percussion and polyrhythmic singing.
music_profile.sound_description: A dense layer of polyrhythmic drumming and handclaps supporting a pentatonic vocal melody. The sound is communal and driving, lacking the complex string harmonies of West Africa but emphasizing rhythmic entrainment.
music_profile.vocal_style: Pentatonic, group chants, sometimes solo melismatic singing in related Sahelian-influenced styles.

basic_steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, weight on the balls of the feet.
Raise arms above the head, curving them inward to mimic bull horns.
Engage the core and perform a vertical leap, extending the legs fully.
Land softly on the balls of the feet and immediately prepare for the next pulse.
Join the communal circle, moving rhythmically to the pentatonic chant.
teaching.formation: Men in a central jumping area or line; women in a surrounding circle.
teaching.level_notes: Beginners should focus on the 'horn' arm posture and rhythmic clapping before attempting high leaps.
teaching.rhythm: Polyrhythmic with a steady underlying pulse
